items.title: Geopolitics Looms Over Eurovision, but Not Its Asian Edition
items.en: Geopolitics Looms Over Eurovision, but Not Its Asian Edition. So far, the contest’s organizers have kept politics offstage. The European edition shows how difficult that can be.
items.zh: 地緣政治籠罩著歐洲電視網，但亞洲版並非如此。到目前為止，比賽的組織者一直將政治置於幕後。歐洲版顯示這有多麼困難。

items.title: How Some Flights Were Exempt From the Ground Stop
items.en: How Some Flights Were Exempt From the Ground Stop. Dozens of international flights departed from the United States during Friday’s nationwide ground stop. Some planes also left for Hawaii from the West Coast.
items.zh: 某些航班如何免除地面停留。在週五的全國地面停留期間，有數十架國際航班從美國起飛。有些飛機也從西海岸飛往夏威夷。

items.title: I inherited $1.4 million from my father. Am I wrong to ask my husband of 25 years for a postnuptial agreement?
items.en: I inherited $1.4 million from my father. Am I wrong to ask my husband of 25 years for a postnuptial agreement?. “He has always said he wants his daughter to inherit a chunk of his estate, and I’ve never objected to that.”

items.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
items.en: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?. “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

items.en: Nvidia's leadership crisis rattles the AI trade. Here's how we're adjusting our portfolio. Despite the turbulence, the S&P 500 secured a weekly gain of 2.5%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq added 2.3%.

items.title: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors
items.en: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors. Two Nvidia investors with about $2.13 billion of stock disclosed as of June 30 are calling for a deliberate leadership search after Huang’s resignation.
items.zh: 兩位主要投資者敦促英偉達董事會考慮「黃仁勳的潛在回報」。截至 6 月 30 日，英偉達的兩名投資者已披露其股票價值約 21.3 億美元，他們呼籲在黃仁勳辭職後認真尋找領導層。

items.title: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short
items.en: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short. A pair economists argue in a new book that people are more creative and productive when they work together in person. But it's not enough for employers to simply order workers back to the office.
items.zh: 這些經濟學家表示，面對面的工作可以提高創造力，但辦公室的規定卻不夠。兩位經濟學家在一本新書中指出，當人們一起工作時，他們會更有創造力和生產力。但雇主僅僅命令員工返回辦公室是不夠的。

items.title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
items.en: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home. Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.
items.zh: 由 Eric Trump支持的機器人士兵新創公司在創始人向公司借了460萬美元買房後無法支付員工工資。由 Eric Trump 支持的機器人新創公司未來工業基金會 (Foundation Future Industries) 現金不足，且未能發放工資，執行長桑卡特帕塔克 (Sankaet Pathak) 面臨 460 萬美元公司貸款的審查。

items.title: SpaceX Makes History With Successful Rocket Catch in Texas
items.en: SpaceX Makes History With Successful Rocket Catch in Texas. The Starship spacecraft returned from orbit to the same spot where it lifted off, marking a key milestone in SpaceX’s vision of building fully reusable rockets.
items.zh: SpaceX 在德克薩斯州成功捕獲火箭，創造了歷史。星艦飛船從軌道返回到其升空的同一地點，標誌著 SpaceX 建造完全可重複使用火箭願景的一個重要里程碑。

items.title: Family Dollar to Pay $63 Million Settlement for Overcharging Customers
items.en: Family Dollar to Pay $63 Million Settlement for Overcharging Customers. Since 2023, the discount retailer has been overcharging shoppers “millions of dollars” at checkout, according to a complaint filed by federal regulators and 17 states.
items.zh: Family Dollar 將為多收費用的客戶支付 6,300 萬美元和解金。根據聯邦監管機構和 17 個州提交的投訴，自 2023 年以來，這家折扣零售商一直在結帳時向購物者多收「數百萬美元」的費用。

items.title: 'Root cause’ of nationwide ground stop is unknown, FAA says
items.en: 'Root cause’ of nationwide ground stop is unknown, FAA says. Routers and networking equipment may be involved in the problems that led to the ground stop, but a definitive cause has not been established, officials said.
items.zh: 美國聯邦航空局表示，全國地面停車的「根本原因」尚不清楚。官員表示，路由器和網路設備可能與導致地面停止的問題有關，但具體原因尚未確定。

items.en: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips. The U.S. Commerce Department is under scrutiny for clearing Chinese companies to handle Nvidia chips, despite national security concerns from cabinet officials and U.S. intelligence agencies.
